title: Microsoft Purview: new Data Security Posture Management experience with objectives, AI observability and agents
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, opt-in requirement, licensing statements and control paths are supported by the sources checked. The searches confirmed the narrowly stated gaps in base licensing, automation and a published per-run consumption rate.
